  from: testdata/tmux-live

Layout: 3 tab(s), 4 lane(s), 7 pane(s)
  tab 1 "api:editor"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/src/api
              start: vim .
    lane 2
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/src/api
      pane 2  cwd: $HOME/src/api/test
              start: go test ./...
  tab 2 "api:server"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/src/api
              start: make run
  tab 3 "notes:main"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: /srv/notes
      pane 2  cwd: /srv/notes
              start: tail -f notes.log | grep TODO
      pane 3  cwd: /srv/notes/my drafts
  Start commands are not run now: they run when you run the generated script.
